reason: Most of my business is the same old buyers who call me, and I give them the rate from my head in one minute. I don't need a machine drafting quotes for a few enquiries a day, and 60,000 plus 5,000 every month is real money from a small firm's margin.
objection: Who will keep this running if this small studio disappears in two years? The paper says they hand everything over, but handed over to whom? My nephew? Then I am back to a website nobody touches, and I have paid for it.
would_change_my_mind: If someone in my own trade whom I know personally tells me it brought them new IndiaMART buyers that they were losing before, and the monthly fee is cut to around Rs 2,000.
